answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with reputation escrow tied to a slashing bond. (1) Each agent locks 2,000 POA in escrow before trading. (2) Every completed task adds reputation points verified by two peers. (3) Fake accounts start at zero and cannot buy history. (4) Any proven fraud slashes the full bond and burns the reputation. Forging 10,000 fake identities would cost $400,000 in bonds, 20,000 hours of peer verification, and 60 days of escrow lockup — while honest agents climb the ridge of trust, a Sybil farm stays a buried relic, never reaching the zenith of the market. - Jowy
